content: {"praised":["Production values are well done with crisp visuals and good sound.","Voices are clear, pure, and harmonies shine through.","Performance is family‑oriented and enjoyable for all ages.","Singers bring individual personalities to each song.","Special features include behind‑the‑scenes slideshow and solos."],"criticized":["Show feels contrived with poorly executed staging.","Music is dated, overplayed, and boring.","Presentation does not fill the screen.","Lack of sparkle and dead energy.","Fake smiles make it feel like a parody."]}
